chose: doorman holds and replays only bodiless requests and requests that arrive while waking; a request with a body whose first connect fails gets 503 Retry-After, and a WebSocket whose connect fails is closed for the client to reconnect into the hold
over: buffering every request body so any first-failed request can be replayed
because: httpxy pipes the body into the failed upstream request and closes the client socket on a failed WebSocket connect, so neither can be replayed; buffering bodies would cap uploads and hold memory per request
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
